notes.title: Bumble Brawlers Update! 🛠️
notes.content:
We’ve got a fresh update rolling out with some important fixes and a brand-new menu! Check out what’s new:

✅ Fixed: Plus/minus icons for stat changes in the item shop now display properly on the right-hand side.
🛍️ New Feature: Added a menu where you can view your current items and gear at a glance!

Jump in and check out the improvements! As always, let us know what you think, and keep brawling! 💥🐝

notes.title: Patch Notes – Latest Update!
notes.content:
Hello Bumble Brawlers!

I pushed out a new update that should help a lot with the overall experience for you while you play the game.

[list]
[*] No More Game-Breaking Store Glitch! – Pausing while shopping no longer sends your game into the abyss. Feel free to browse without fear!
[*] Fewer Chest Monsters! – We love surprises, but not too many. Expect a more balanced dungeon experience.
[*] Better Item Comparison! – Stats now have individual plus/minus icons, making it much easier to see if you're upgrading or downgrading at a glance.
[*] Polytown Looks Better Than Ever! – The screenshot now properly reflects the new bridge, because details matter.
[/list]
Enjoy the update, and happy adventuring! 🚀🔥

notes.title: 🔥 Boss Buffs, AK-47 Boost & Key Fixes! 🔥
notes.content:
🔥 Major Update – Boss Buffs, Weapon Balancing & More! 🔥

Survivors, get ready for a harder-hitting and more intense challenge! This update brings a host of improvements, balancing tweaks, and bug fixes to keep the fight against the undead fresh and ferocious. Here’s what’s new:

💀 Boss Overhaul – They’re meaner, tougher, and deadlier! Bosses now have new abilities and increased health, making every encounter a true test of survival.

🔫 AK-47 Buffed – The AK-47 now delivers more power and reliability, making it an even deadlier tool in your arsenal.

🏙️ Polytown Crash Fixed – No more unexpected exits—this area is now fully stable.

📊 Stat Upgrade Visibility Fixed – Upgrades now appear immediately after purchase, so you can see your progress without waiting for the next round.

🛡️ Better Armor Comparison – Wondering if that new gear is an upgrade? Now the store clearly shows improvements, making it easier to gear up effectively.

🤖 Companion Spawn Fix – Your allies now show up when they should! No more missing companions when you need them most.

Jump back in, test your skills, and let us know what you think! Your feedback keeps us pushing forward. Stay sharp, stay alive!
